title: Ouma language
description: Extinct language formerly spoken in Papua New Guinea
extract: Ouma is an extinct Austronesian language of Papua New Guinea. It was restructured through contact with neighboring Papuan languages, and it turn influencing them, before speakers shifted to those languages.
